key_highlights: ASX set to slump as oil hits $US100 (highest since May), dragging miners and banks lower; Wall Street slips third straight day
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, raising rate-path uncertainty
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Albo government softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; positive for energy sector
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable housing remains resilient; NSW faces stamp duty revenue hit
AUD shocker looms amid oil-driven global risk-off and Chinese inflation surge
Power giant seeks AI data centres at coal plants; NSW energy supply under strain

sectors.trend: Bearish. Iron ore trouble spreads; oil at $100 lifts input costs but demand concerns persist. Copper strength (Flagship) and gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) provide pockets of support.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term pressure from iron ore softness. Copper and gold explorers (Flagship, Kuniko) offer relative outperformance. Monitor iron ore contract pricing.

sectors.trend: Bearish. Rising bond yields and oil-driven risk-off pressure bank shares. RBA rental inflation concern complicates rate-cut timeline. Bathla private credit collapse adds credit-risk overhang.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX likely underperform. Private credit stress (Bathla) may widen credit spreads. RBA hawkish tilt on rents delays rate cuts, pressuring valuations.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. $100 oil supports upstream but Albo's gas reservation softening eases Asian supply fears. AI data centre demand at coal plants creates new energy demand narrative. NSW power supply risk.
sectors.implications: SAP.AX, WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from gas policy shift. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (Powerlink/Origin) is a structural theme. NSW energy security risk is a policy catalyst.

sectors.trend: Cautious. Woolworths price increases during 'Price Freeze' erode consumer trust. Housing divergence (high-end falls, affordable resilient) signals bifurcated consumer spending.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Consumer staples remain defensive but growth is constrained. Monitor CPI and retail sales data.

sectors.trend: Selective. Austal $1.9b bid is a positive M&A signal. AI data centre buildout at coal sites creates infrastructure demand. Global tech (Palantir, Okta) shows AI momentum but TTD cuts 15% workforce.
sectors.implications: Austal bid validates industrial M&A activity. AI infrastructure theme supports ASX-listed data centre and power plays. Global tech volatility is a sentiment risk.

sectors.trend: Neutral. No major sector-specific headlines. Housing market divergence (high-end falls) pressures property REITs at premium end. Super access rules (One Nation proposal) create policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains a defensive anchor. Premium property REITs (e.g., VMC.AX, GPT.AX) face headwinds from high-end price falls. Super policy debate is a medium-term watch item.

key_themes: Oil at $100 triggering global risk-off and TACO (trade assets, cash out) dynamics
RBA rental inflation focus complicates rate-cut expectations
Iron ore demand weakness spreading through mining sector
Gas policy liberalisation under Albo easing Asian LNG supply concerns
Private credit stress (Bathla) as emerging systemic risk
Housing market bifurcation: high-end correction vs affordable resilience
AI data centre energy demand reshaping power sector
AUD weakness risk from oil shock and Chinese inflation
Chinese inflation surge as global growth risk

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; increase allocation to defensive staples and gold; monitor OPEC+ supply response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hawkish surprise on rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property); favour fixed-income ladders
Review exposure to private credit funds; favour listed, transparent credit instruments
Hedge USD-denominated liabilities; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) as natural AUD hedge
Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure; favour copper/gold miners
Monitor AEMO data; favour generators and grid infrastructure plays

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper explorers amid iron ore weakness
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreads while copper soars and gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) shows pipeline depth; diversification away from iron ore

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas and power infrastructure exposure on policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Albo softens gas reservation; AI data centre demand at coal plants creates structural energy demand; NSW supply risk supports generators

opportunities.recommendation: Position for Austal M&A and industrial consolidation
opportunities.rationale: $1.9b bid validates industrial M&A; defence and shipbuilding demand supports sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce bank and REIT exposure ahead of RBA rental inflation commentary
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hawkish tilt on rents delays rate cuts; rising yields pressure bank NIMs and REIT valuations; Bathla adds credit overhang

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with export-oriented miners and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker looms on oil-driven risk-off and Chinese inflation; gold and copper miners provide natural currency hedge

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase allocation to consumer staples as defensive anchor
defensive_moves.rationale: Woolworths price hikes signal margin pressure but staples retain defensive demand; housing bifurcation supports affordable-end consumption

market_outlook.short_term: ASX faces headwinds from $100 oil, iron ore weakness, and RBA rental inflation concerns. Expect continued downside in miners and banks. Gas policy shift and Austal M&A provide selective pockets. Sentiment is risk-averse; TACO dynamics may persist 1–2 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots on rents. AI data centre energy demand, gas liberalisation, and copper/gold exploration offer structural themes. Housing bifurcation and private credit stress are medium-term risks to monitor.

Iron ore contract pricing and Chinese demand data
Bathla private credit resolution and contagion
watch_list: RBA cash rate and rental inflation data
SAP.AX, WDS.AX gas volumes and policy updates
Bathla / private credit fund NAV disclosures
